title: Matemágico · Cortocircuito y ∂Q/∂t Condensador
description: docs/animas/matemagico/README.md § Cortocircuito and ∂Q/∂t Condensador (Aitor 2026-11-21): the electric line past Toma de tierra. In the fight tester against three sturdy dogs that hit back, one player leading both. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 600; }); s.allies.forEach(a => { a.hp = a.maxHp = 400; }); });

steps.caption: The electric line with its two new nodes: Punto eléctrico, Cortocircuito and ∂Q/∂t Condensador
∂Q/∂t Condensador: ∂Q over ∂t written in his circle, two plates slide in either side with arcs between them, and it all draws into Gerard: ¡Cargado!
Gerard carries the charge: little sparks off him and the capacitor's icon on his plate (×2)
The dogs' turn: the one that bites Gerard takes the charge, lightning from him to it (∂Q/∂t · la carga salta)

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes[0].timed = { ...s.foes[0].timed, mojado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 20 } }; delete s.foes[0].shock; delete s.foes[0].shorted; })

steps.caption: Cortocircuito on a wet dog: a resistor drawn in his circle flies to it and snaps in two; the current stays in it: ¡Cortocircuito! and ¡Shock!, nothing jumps to the others
With the charge on, Punto eléctrico lets it go: the plates flash open over the dog and the blow lands twice as hard (×2)
